subject: comparing spatial and temporal covariates in dynocc model

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: comparing spatial and temporal covariates in dynocc model
parts:
Dear all,

I was wondering about the comparison of site covariates (which describe purely spatial variation) and yearly site covariates (which describe spatio-temporal variation) in the colonization and extinction parameters in a dynamic occupancy model. We fitted some model and used methods described by Beale et al. (here: http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/2041-210X.12174/abstract) to compare the relative influence of the two types of covariates. However, we got criticized by some colleagues who thought we're comparing apples and oranges. Also, they seemed to think that site covariates were intrinsically "preferred" in such a comparison, meaning, automatically showing up as more important somehow.

Does anybody have an opinion on this or pointers to relevant papers ?

Thanks a lot and kind regards  --  Marc
